_readme: ONE set of expected twelve-month costs, read by all four copies of the cost engine.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The engine is implemented four times because no single
module can be imported into a browser IIFE, a Next bundle, a Flutter app and a
Deno function at once:
site/plan-cost.js                      site/plan-cost.test.js
web/lib/plan-cost.ts                   web/lib/__tests__/plan-cost.test.ts
lib/services/plan_cost.dart            test/plan_cost_test.dart
supabase/functions/_shared/plan_cost.ts  supabase/functions/tests/plan_cost_test.ts
They drifted, and it cost real money: a free-month rule landed in the site copy
alone, and for a day the app and the web app billed yes+Fiber הטריפל ₪2,508 for
a year in which the plan gives the first month away — ₪209 worse than the site
said, in our own comparison. Each copy had its own tests and every suite was
green, because each pinned its own behaviour.
So the expected numbers now live HERE, once. Every copy's test reads this file
and asserts against it, which makes a change to one engine that is not made to
the others fail in the other three.
ADDING A CASE: add it here, then run all four suites. If a case is genuinely
meaningful on only some surfaces, say so in its `note` rather than silently
leaving a copy untested — a case nobody runs is how this file stops working.
FIELDS. `plan` uses the catalogue's own field names; every engine reads the
same ones (price/priceExact/after/afterExact + fineLines/terms/notes).
`expect.basis` uses the JS/TS string spelling; the Dart test maps it to the
PriceBasis enum. `minimum`/`maximum` are the twelve-month totals in ₪.

cases.name: the exact price wins over the rounded headline
cases.note: ₪10.90 rounds to 11 for sorting; money math must not.

cases.name: after <= price is not a promo
a published ladder beats both the promo and the after price
cases.note: The real net_partner_fiber1g row. Displayed ₪936 over 24 months once; the ladder makes the first year ₪1,468.

cases.name: a promo with a published duration runs exactly that long
an unpublished duration returns a RANGE rather than a guess
cases.note: Floor = promo forever, ceiling = one promo month. Savings claims must net off the ceiling.

cases.name: a tier that starts after the horizon confirms the headline covers it
a published free first month is not charged
cases.note: The real tri_yes_yes-fiber-triple row — the case that proved the four copies had drifted.

cases.name: a free ADD-ON is never mistaken for a free subscription month
cases.note: 24 catalogue plans say חינם/מתנה and nearly all mean a router, a SIM delivery or a streaming trial. Zeroing month 1 would invent a discount.

cases.name: a free first month with NO published ladder is left alone
cases.note: The real cel_walla_family300 row. With no ladder we would be inventing a schedule, not refining one — overstating the cost understates the saving, the safe direction.

cases.name: the ladder is read from terms as well as fineLines
cases.note: The live public.plans row carries `terms` as a single string.

cases.name: the ladder is read from notes too
a row with no price at all yields zero, not NaN
